title: Elevated 504 Gateway Timeouts in Checkout API during flash sale
description: During the autumn flash sale, checkout-api experienced a 4.2% rate of HTTP 504 timeouts due to upstream latency spikes in the legacy acquirer endpoint. Resolved by enabling retry circuit breakers and scaling replica pods from 6 to 14.

title: Fraud scoring latency spike (>450ms) affecting checkout completion
description: P99 latency on /v1/evaluate-risk breached 450ms (SLO target is 200ms). Root cause suspected to be an unindexed database query on device fingerprint lookup tables.

title: Stale price cache reported for international currency conversions
description: EUR and GBP prices failed to invalidate after midnight exchange rate sync. Caused discrepancies of ~0.3% on order subtotals for 45 minutes until cache flush.

title: Upgrade redis cluster memory limits in staging and prod
description: Increase Redis instance size from cache.m5.large to cache.m6g.xlarge to support higher TTL on multi-region product catalog items.

title: Implement OpenTelemetry traces across payment-gateway-adapter
description: Inject baggage headers for w3c traceparent to correlate payment auth attempts with downstream acquirer gateway logs.

title: Review missing runbook coverage for payment notification fallback
description: Onboarding doc and emergency runbook do not cover dead letter queue (DLQ) replay procedures when Kafka consumer groups rebalance.
